newsitem.title: UK: Tesco advances as buyers sidle in.
newsitem.headline: Tesco advances as buyers sidle in.

text.p: Shares in British supermarket group Tesco Plc rose 5-1/2p to 382-1/2p in brisk trading on Wednesday although dealers and market makers said there was no particular story behind the buying interest.
Nearly 3.5 million changed hands by 1406 GMT.
"There's been some business but no story. They were trading at 75/77 (375p bid/377p offered) and there was a rumour someone was bidding outside the price for clients," said a market maker.
J. Sainsbury Plc put on 1-1/2p to 363p with more than two million shares traded. Dealers said UBS bought 1,000 July 360p call options.
Kwiksave Plc rose 2-1/2p to 287-1/2p and Safeway Plc 1/2p to 359p.
